items.title: 6. Average Kinetic Energy is Proportional to Temperature

source_refs.note: 6. Average Kinetic Energy is Proportional to Temperature: a main subheading of 6.1 Assumptions of the kinetic theory of gases, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 119-119.

blocks.text: The average kinetic energy of gas particles is directly proportional to the absolute temperature of the gas. This implies that as the temperature increases, the speed of the gas particles also increases.
